population.disease: high-risk, nonmetastatic locally advanced colon adenocarcinoma
population.stage: clinical T4 and/or bulky node-positive disease; M0

inclusion: tumor more than 15 cm from anal verge
no previous anticancer treatment or immunotherapy
exclusion: serious medical disease, including severe psychiatric disease, cardiac disease or uncontrolled infection

protocol_registry_discrepancies: Registry exclusion list does not include MSI-H, while published protocol excludes MSI-H and results explicitly describe pMMR/MSS.
Registry creatinine threshold is <=1 ULN, whereas the published protocol table is <=1.5 ULN.

design.design: prospective, multicentre, randomized, two-arm, open-label superiority trial
design.randomization: central computer-generated randomization; stratified/balanced by primary tumor location and lymph-node stage/status
design.setting: Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center plus six other Chinese centres in published protocol

hypothesis_for_sample_size.note: Protocol describes a 95% probability of selecting the superior group. Do not relabel this as a reported treatment-effect CI or reconstruct an unspecified power calculation.

experimental_A.sequence: SCRT, then 4 cycles serplulimab plus CAPOX; radical resection after reassessment; 4 adjuvant CAPOX cycles planned

radiotherapy.target: primary colon lesion and enlarged nodes only; elective nodal drainage regions excluded
radiotherapy.protocol_technique: IMRT with colonoscopic titanium clips for image guidance
radiotherapy.later_ASTRO_technique: CT-linac with daily diagnostic CT-guided online adaptive radiotherapy

capecitabine.daily_frequency: not explicitly stated in the inspected abstract, protocol or registry

control_B.sequence: 4 neoadjuvant CAPOX cycles; radical resection after reassessment; 4 adjuvant CAPOX cycles planned

surgery_timing.protocol: reassessment 2 or 4 weeks after neoadjuvant treatment, then radical resection
surgery_timing.registry: surgery scheduled 2-4 weeks after neoadjuvant therapy
surgery_timing.preferred_procedure: colectomy with regional en-bloc lymph-node dissection

interventions.important_causal_scope: Both radiation and PD-1 blockade are added in A. The two-arm comparison cannot isolate the effect of either addition.

randomized.note: Do not label 60/60 as directly reported actual randomized arm counts. They are the protocol planned allocation; main abstract reports total and ratio only.

reported_thrombocytopenia_denominators.relationship: numerically identical to reported mITT set; a distinct safety-set definition is not given

denominators.participant_flow_gap: Arithmetic differences between the separately reported totals are 13 (120 minus 107) and 4 (107 minus 103). Participant-level mapping and mITT definition are not reported; do not infer which patients were excluded or unoperated, their reasons or outcomes.

primary.name: pathological complete response/regression (pCR)
primary.definition_protocol: no viable tumor on complete histological assessment; assessed by two independent pathologists
primary.definition_registry: no malignant cells in resected primary site and regional nodes
primary.caution: Do not describe the response percentages as a 3-year outcome.

endpoints.toxicity_assessment_protocol: CTCAE v5.0, recorded each treatment cycle
endpoints.QoL_assessment_protocol: EORTC QLQ-C30 after neoadjuvant therapy and every 6 months during follow-up

registry_survival_time_origins.OS: randomization to all-cause death, assessed through 3 years
registry_survival_time_origins.DFS: randomization to first documented progression or death, assessed through 3 years
registry_survival_time_origins.LRFS: randomization to first locoregional failure, assessed through 3 years

endpoints.registry_long_term_safety: grade3-4 events assessed through 5 years; surgical complications assessed through 5 years after surgery
endpoints.results_for_3_year_survival: not reported in verified main results sources

safety.ASTRO_only_qualitative_RT_AE: grade1-2 diarrhea and abdominal pain described as most common; no counts or percentages supplied
safety.warning: These thrombocytopenia rates are not overall severe-AE rates. Missing death/immune-AE data are not evidence of zero events.

results.authors_interpretation_paraphrase: The combination produced a promising higher pCR rate. The proposed R0/survival benefits are hypotheses, not measured survival results in these abstracts.
results.reviewer_interpretation: Exploratory phase II evidence of higher pCR among operated patients; does not establish randomized-population pCR, survival benefit, or practice-changing benefit-risk.

dates.rule: Keep enrollment range, publication/presentation dates, publisher abstract-currency footer, registry estimates and actual analysis cutoff separate. The current results abstracts do not explicitly name a clinical analysis cutoff.
dates.date_discrepancy: Protocol first recruitment Mar24 2023 differs from the 2026 abstract enrollment range starting Apr3 2023. The earlier ASCO GI abstract says 120 enrolled by Aug31 2025, whereas the later report gives an enrollment end Sep9 2025. Do not silently harmonize these dates.

thrombocytopenia_grade3_4.population: patients completing neoadjuvant treatment, pooled arms

earlierASCOGI.handling: Retain earlier source and analysis history; do not mix its R0 fractions or n98 safety set into ASCO3634/ASTRO2287 denominators. It is not an independent trial.

TORCH-C.relatedARTPaperScope: A 40-patient radiotherapy implementation/feasibility full paper exists; it is not the two-arm randomized efficacy publication and its safety denominator is not merged.
limitations: Conference-only main efficacy results with no complete randomized trial report identified.
Small phase II open-label study; pathological surrogate endpoint rather than demonstrated long-term benefit.
pCR fractions are for operated patients, despite a separately stated mITT set; mITT definition and post-randomization exclusions are unexplained.
No confidence interval, exact P value, comparative relative/absolute effect estimate or analysis-test method reported for current pCR results.
No clinical cutoff or median follow-up reported in current abstracts; planned 3-year endpoints are not observed survival results.
Limited safety reporting: main abstract supplies one severe AE category; no overall severe AE, immune-related AE, surgery complication or fatal-event count.
Combination adds two modalities, so the incremental role of radiotherapy versus PD-1 inhibition cannot be separated.
Latest registry remains an old pre-recruitment record with minor protocol discrepancies, not a contemporary outcome source.
Related 40-patient ART full paper and later conference repetition do not cure the randomized efficacy reporting limitations.

methods: Public web search for exact TORCH-C and NCT05732493, 2026 results, survival/follow-up, full publication, correction/retraction/erratum; primary ASCO and ASTRO sources inspected.
PubMed ESearch exact TORCH-C or NCT05732493, publication dates1900-01-01 through2026-11-09; results read.
latestEvidenceCheck.PubMed_query: ("TORCH-C"[All Fields] OR "NCT05732493"[All Fields]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/11/09"[Date - Publication])
latestEvidenceCheck.findings: Located ASCO GI147, ASCO3634, ASTRO2287, the protocol and the ART feasibility publication. No full two-arm efficacy publication, mature survival report, correction or retraction was identified in these bounded checks.
latestEvidenceCheck.caveat: Absence from these searches is not proof none exists; indexing lags and unindexed meeting material remain possible.
excluded_near_names: other nonrandomized rectal short-course radiotherapy studies

sourceAccessLimits: ASCO direct page open returned HTTP403; complete primary publisher-indexed abstract/PDF text was verified.
Official ASTRO full abstract was read; linked poster page yielded no extracted text, and no values were taken from an unseen poster.
Full protocol was read via public Europe PMC XML.

TORCH-E2.decision: Retain pending, replace old history-access blocker with verified V1 facts
TORCH-E2.interpretation: This verifies the registered regimen and the absence of a later visible posted version. It does not establish which drug was administered in the conference-reported cohort.
TORCH-E2.abstractFinding: Page 735 still names pembrolizumab in the title, objective and methods. Page 736 continues the results and states final comparative outcomes await enrollment and further follow-up. No correction or explanation of the drug discrepancy was visible on these pages.
TORCH-E2.correctionSearch: No accessible corrected primary abstract or official explanation was identified. Search indexing still showed the ESTRO program title with pembrolizumab, but the direct session-page open returned Page Not Found/offline content and was not used to resolve the claim.

scopeLimit: Targeted historical backfill, not a repeat or extension of the completed daily broad source search. No inferred confidence intervals, survival curves, pooled cohorts, or cross-trial ranking.
